searchText: Quick question, if I take the pinned kurtosis config and latest commit of ethereum-package, am I supposed to see more than 6 blobs in electra? I'm only using geth as EL at this moment, another way to ask this is does it use the latest genesis json i’m not sure version of geth the config would run but unless it’s one of our prague-devnet-5 branches, we would still have max=6 hardcoded you can run lightclient/go-ethereum:prague-devnet-5 If you use the pinned version in this channel then yes it will use > 6 blobs 🙂 Its using sina's branch for now, but yeah using lightclient's branch would also achieve the same outcome Our default for electra in the genesis generator now is 6/9 at electra_fork_epoch, the `spamoor_blob_params` specifies the blob spammer config. It'll try to fill up the queue so there's 10 blobs in the pool. So we should be at target more often than not. thanks a lot guys, confirming it works for prysm
